svg.title: Honey Token: tested event paths
svg.desc: Two independent tests. A local DOCX opened in Word and produced a stored event and console alert. Controlled HTTPS requests to Azure produced Table events, Log Analytics records, and a Sentinel incident.

g.text: The document and cloud paths were exercised separately.
